name: example-motion-muda-inference-film
title: Muda Inference Film
description: Muda turns waiting into waste removed: a chat wait, utilization grid, token stream, name definition, pastel wordmark and timing receipt.

description_i18n.en: Muda turns waiting into waste removed: a chat wait, utilization grid, token stream, name definition, pastel wordmark and timing receipt.
description_i18n.zh-CN: muda 通过聊天等待、利用率网格、词元流、品牌释义、渐变品牌字和计时回执，展示推理等待如何被消除。

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.label: 开场问题
inputs.default: Summarize the quarter in one line.

inputs.name: receiptLine
inputs.label: 计时说明
inputs.default: We were done before the logo was.

inputs.name: contextLine
inputs.label: 释义背景
inputs.default:
The first of the three wastes in the Toyota

query.en: Make a 26-second inference performance film for {{brand}}, with {{font}} typography, {{ink}} text and {{accent}} accents on white. Open with a rounded chat bubble typing “{{prompt}}”, then a spinning Thinking indicator, shimmering placeholder lines and an accelerating wait counter. Cut to giant “{{waitingWord}}”, strike it through with a purple rule, then flash “{{wasteWord}}” in white on purple. Build a 32-by-10 cluster grid under “{{clusterLine}}”, label idle, padding, cold start and queue, show 31% utilization, and sweep pastel squares across it until 94% and “{{resolvedLine}}”. Fill the frame with moving pastel token pills around a white throughput panel, accelerating to {{throughput}} tok/s and {{firstToken}} ms first token. Switch to the dictionary-style name {{brand}}, a hand-drawn dark ensō circle and large pale 無駄 characters: “無駄 — {{definition}}”, “{{contextLine}}” and “{{alsoLine}}” appear in sequence. Reveal “{{claim}}”, followed by “{{claimSecond}}”, with vertical “{{japanese}}” on the right. Sweep a diagonal pastel gradient ribbon behind the bold {{brand}} wordmark and “{{tagline}}”. End with the film length 26.000 s versus the answer time derived from {{firstToken}} milliseconds, “{{receiptLine}}”, and a small centered wordmark. Keep crosshair corners, chapter labels, a running timecode and the thin purple progress rule throughout.
query.zh-CN: 为 {{brand}} 制作约 26 秒的推理性能宣传片，白底，使用 {{font}} 字体、{{ink}} 文字和 {{accent}} 强调色。开场让圆角聊天气泡逐字输入「{{prompt}}」，随后出现旋转的 Thinking 指示、扫光占位条和加速的等待计时。切到巨大的「{{waitingWord}}」，用紫色横线划掉，再闪切成紫底白字「{{wasteWord}}」。在「{{clusterLine}}」下逐格生成 32×10 的计算网格，标注闲置、填充、冷启动和排队，显示 31% 利用率；彩色方格从左向右扫过后变成 94% 和「{{resolvedLine}}」。满屏的彩色词元胶囊加速横移，中央白卡显示吞吐量升至 {{throughput}} tok/s，首词元延迟降至 {{firstToken}} ms。然后展示词典式 {{brand}} 品牌名、深蓝手绘圆相与巨大的浅紫「無駄」，依次出现「無駄 — {{definition}}」「{{contextLine}}」和「{{alsoLine}}」。逐词揭示「{{claim}}」，接着是「{{claimSecond}}」，右侧竖排「{{japanese}}」。一条斜切的柔和彩色渐变带扫入，承托粗体 {{brand}} 品牌字与「{{tagline}}」。片尾对照影片 26.000 s 与由 {{firstToken}} 毫秒换算的回答时间，出现「{{receiptLine}}」，最后缩为中央小品牌字。全程保留四角十字、章节名、动态时间码和底部紫色进度细线。
